summary: Oriented on the active assignment repo-requirements-audit-v1 (supersedes workflow-schedule-audit-v1): audit every checklist-engine stage/requirement against immutable main evidence and publish matrices, evidence ledger, corrected Gantt and report under docs/venice-audit-v1/ on venice/repo-requirements-audit-v1, deliverable merged_pr. No audit artifact exists yet on the audit branch; this turn only reads the task spec, the two Gantt claim baselines, and the head SHAs of the audit branch and main so the first write (docs/venice-audit-v1/PROGRESS.json) can be made with a correct expected_sha.
next: Read the returned spec/baseline content, then create_branch venice/repo-requirements-audit-v1 from the returned main head if it does not exist, and write docs/venice-audit-v1/PROGRESS.json with expected_sha null (or the returned audit-branch sha if the branch already exists).

plan.why: Advances the Venice lane row for the Cyrus-assigned full repository audit and prevents missing requirements or false completion claims before any gate is considered.

contribution.description: Confirmed from the live bridge context that the active contract is repo-requirements-audit-v1 on venice/repo-requirements-audit-v1 with allowed_paths limited to docs/venice-audit-v1/**, the validator script, its test and its workflow, and that it explicitly supersedes workflow-schedule-audit-v1; also confirmed no audit branch PR exists yet (task_pr null), so the first deliverable action is branch creation plus PROGRESS.json.
